ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of the Ming Great Wall. The Great Wall extends eastward from "Jiayuguan" in the west, passes through "Juyongguan" near Beijing, and reaches "Shanhaiguan" at the eastern end. The figure shows that the western section is located in China's northwestern inland area, while the eastern section is located in eastern North China, close to the ocean and in an area more obviously affected by the monsoon. Then reason: the question stem says that the western half was entirely built with rammed earth, while the eastern half was built with brick and stone on the outside and rammed earth on the inside. China's precipitation generally decreases from the southeast to the northwest, so the eastern half of the Great Wall has more precipitation, and rainwater erodes rammed earth more strongly, requiring an outer wrapping of brick and stone; the western half has less precipitation and an arid climate, so rammed earth is not easily damaged by rainwater and can be built entirely with rammed earth.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：图中长城从西部的“嘉峪关”向东延伸到北京附近的“居庸关”，再到东端“山海关”，显示西段位于中国西北内陆，东段位于华北、近海和季风影响较强地区。再读取题干文字：西半段全部用夯土筑成，东半段外部用砖石砌成、内部夯土，要求判断造成差异的降水条件。结合中国降水由东南向西北递减的地理规律，东段降水较多，夯土容易被雨水侵蚀，所以外部需用砖石；西段降水少、气候干旱，夯土不易受雨水破坏，可以全部用夯土。答案为：东半段降水多，西半段降水少。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一幅明长城分布示意图，长城从西部的“嘉峪关”向东延伸，经过北京附近的“居庸关”，到达东端的“山海关”。图示表明西段位于中国西北内陆，东段位于华北东部、靠近海洋且受季风影响更明显的地区。再推理：题干说西半段全部用夯土筑成，东半段外部用砖石砌成、内部夯土。中国降水总体由东南向西北递减，因此长城东半段降水较多，雨水对夯土侵蚀较强，需要外包砖石；西半段降水较少、气候干旱，夯土不易被雨水破坏，可以全部用夯土筑成。
method.model_answer: 东半段降水多，西半段降水少。
